timing_scope: Native mesh/data read, assembly, solve, reaction reassembly and binary export; not a controlled performance benchmark
discretization: MSL_CG global conforming triangular P1; SW-NE diagonals; native Eigen SparseLU; raw flux -K grad(p)
permeability_convention: Kx = Ky from unmodified layer 36; piecewise constant on 60 x 220 pixels
units: Original SPE10 numerical coordinates in ft and permeability in mD; no SI conversion
reaction_convention: Outward Darcy reaction is minus the uneliminated native stiffness residual at essential nodes; side zero flux is natural, not a pointwise raw-gradient constraint

previous_difference.integration: Exact P1 mass matrix for pressure; cell areas for piecewise constant flux; nested SW-NE triangles

sample_convention: Pixel centers: lower triangle at diagonal and positive coordinate side at fine-grid boundaries. Profiles x=199: eleven macro intervals retain their separate interior-side endpoint flux limits. Samples are visualization data, not L2 norms.
native_reaction_check: Native uneliminated LCS action checked against independent exact triangular P1 gradients and archived pixel coefficients; no native matrix or solve altered
raw_flux_boundary_convention: Raw P1 flux is not H(div)-conforming and its boundary integrals need not equal the variational reactions; zero side flux is imposed naturally in the weak equation
energy_identity: Integral q.K^-1.q equals minus the bottom outward reaction for p_bottom=1, p_top=0 and homogeneous side Neumann data
